explanation: This fires only at D1, when the previous trial chose a1, got a rare transition to S2, and was rewarded: about 10 if the agent had been choosing a1 steadily through mid-episode (trials 35-70), and about 5-8 otherwise (early or late in the episode, or when the agent switches to a2 on that trial). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and 0 at D1 after any other outcome (common transitions, unrewarded rare transitions, or a2 choices), apart from about 2 on the D1 right after a high one.
